items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who were some of the clarinet players you remember as outstanding? We've already mentioned Aaron and now. Harry Shields.

ctx.x: Well, Horace Dias played at the old Silver Slipper when Jink Morton played down there. Which band was this? I was trying to think of the band. Now, I think my brother-in-law Steve Lloyd Cantor had the band. And I know he definitely had him. Steve was on banjo and Horace Dias was on piano. Jink Morton on bass. I can't remember who the clarinet player was and who the trumpet player he had with at that time. But that was a good band of those days too. It was a real good swinging band.
Who were some of the clarinet players you remember as outstanding? We've already mentioned Aaron and now. Harry Shields.

Harry Shields. Bill Bourgeois. Of course, Raymond. Raymond Burke. And then, of course, to get back to piano players, another fine piano player just entered my mind. A little fella that used to play with Raymond at the Club Plantation. Oh, Julia Chavez. Mm-hmm. Julia Chavez was a good, very good, very good jazz piano player. Played very nice style.
